Nitro Beast: More park-focused, True Twin shape, uses higher-end Tri-Lite Laminates and Powercore II with beech stringers [60] 115. Nitro Team Pro: Stiffer upgrade to Team, adds carbon tape reinforcement and Speed Formula II base for more pop, speed [42][58] 116. Forum opinion — Team as all-rounder: "a great midflex camber board. Fun carving and popping around the resort" [91] 117. Forum opinion — Team flex: One forum user "found the team surprisingly soft.
